d.ko: From the lead designer of Cold Waters, Sea Power lets you control NATO and Warsaw Pact forces in modern naval conflict campaigns. Use your advanced naval weaponry and sensors to respect rules of engagement and defeat the enemy forces in a tense fight for initiative and air/naval supremacy.
d.en: From the lead designer of Cold Waters, Sea Power lets you control NATO and Warsaw Pact forces in modern naval conflict campaigns. Use your advanced naval weaponry and sensors to respect rules of engagement and defeat the enemy forces in a tense fight for initiative and air/naval supremacy.
d.zh: 《海权》，由《冰冷海域》的主设计师为你呈现，让你指挥现代海战中的北约和华约部队。使用先进的武器和传感器，遵守交战规则，在争夺主动权和海空优势的紧张战斗中击败敌军。
